title: Pi Chat canvas and Terminal fallback
description: Create a temporary pi-basic session, verify the Terminal-first Chat tab, submit a model-formatting prompt, observe transport and completion states, replay the completed turn without duplication, and keep Terminal available as the fallback.

requires.cloudRun: Creates a billable pi-basic Cloud Run service
requires.piAuth: A Pi provider must be configured for the QA user if completion evidence is required
requires.manualFallback: If the runner cannot be induced into a controlled Chat error, verify the Open Terminal fallback manually

steps.value: Return a short response with a heading named Markdown smoke, a two-item bullet list, a fenced code block containing console.log('ok'), and a two-column table.

steps.expected: Non-empty assistant bubble is visible; inspect heading, list, code, and table semantics when the model follows the prompt, recording formatting variance as inconclusive.
The completed user and assistant turns replay once after switching Terminal to Chat.
